description:
Create a custom Live Template in IntelliJ IDEA to quickly insert an SLF4J logger.

1. Open Settings > Editor > Live Templates.
2. Create a new Template Group named 'Custom'.
3. Add a new Live Template named 'logger'.
4. Set the template text to: private static final org.slf4j.Logger log = org.slf4j.LoggerFactory.getLogger($CLASS$.class);
5. Edit variables: set $CLASS$ to the expression className().
6. Define the context as 'Java' (or Java > Declaration).
7. Open PaymentService.java and use the new 'logger' template to insert the logger field inside the class.
